answer: One agent tends one yarrow plot, stakes 70, files bloom count and one opal-graded sample. Auditors sample one plot vertex and recount its quadrant against the public bloom table; a count off by over two, a reused sample, or a vertex mismatch burns the stake. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-plot rings fail: borrowed yarrow blooms bear another's opal tag. Honest agents pay 38 once, keep it.
